title: glyphterm scene
description: The scene file a running viewer watches (glyphterm --watch <file>). Every key is optional; the viewer applies the ones present on top of its current state and reports problems in <file>.status.json.

model.description: A primitive (torus, sphere, cube, icosahedron, dodecahedron, octahedron, cuboctahedron, football, star, great-star, cone, cylinder, pyramid, antiprism, cloud, core, buddy, wave, field) or a mesh file (.obj, .stl, .glb, .gltf, .vox), relative to the scene file or absolute.

palette.description: Glyph palette; auto lets each style pick.

color.description: A theme or #rrggbb. original keeps a mesh file's own material colors.

yaw.description: Rotation around the vertical axis in degrees.

pitch.description: Tilt toward the viewer in degrees. Values outside -89..89 are clamped.

zoom.description: Zoom factor; 1 fits the model to the screen. Values outside 0.2..8 are clamped.

spin.description: Auto-rotation in degrees per second; 0 stops it. Values outside -720..720 are clamped.

caption.description: A line of text under the scene; empty hides it.

activity.description: What the avatar shows (glyphterm avatar): a motion for any model, plus a pose for the buddy. error and done are short and return by themselves; "" clears it.

stats.description: Shows the stats line under the scene (the i key toggles it).

spectrum.description: Shows the spectrum analyzer: recent tool calls by kind (the e key toggles it).

contextLimit.description: The context window the stats line's meter fills up to (default 1000000).

session.description: The agent session the stats line shows. glyphterm avatar --hook writes it from the Claude Code transcript.

model.description: The model of the latest reply.

context.description: Tokens the latest request sent: the context in use.

cache.description: Percent of all input read from the prompt cache, subagents included.

output.description: Output tokens so far, subagents included.

tools.description: Tool calls so far, subagents included.

failed.description: Tool calls that came back as errors.

calls.description: The latest tool calls, oldest first: [time in ms, tool group, failed 0 or 1, subagent id or ""].

satellites.description: Subagents still running, drawn as satellites: [id, start time in ms].

seconds.description: Time from the first reply to the latest.

wave.description: Settings of the animated models wave and field.

frequency.description: Periods across the screen. Values outside 0.25..12 are clamped.

amplitude.description: Height of the signal. Values outside 0..1.3 are clamped.

speed.description: Periods per second the trace scrolls. Values outside -5..5 are clamped.

gradient.description: field only: colors from front to back, a preset or a list of #rrggbb.

data.description: field only: demo signals or live load per CPU core.
